title: Super Zugan: Hakotenjou kara no Shoutai - Super Zugan Quiz
description:
This is a song from the Japan-only Super Famicom game, Super Zugan: Hakotenjou kara no Shoutai, a Mahjong game based on the manga of the same name. And surprisingly, it was published by EA out of all companies (yes, we're serious; its sequel, on the other hand, was published by J-Wing, which at least makes more sense).

Note that due to the high echo buffer (in fact, that is unfortunately common with the soundtrack for this game, as well as most other games using the Masakatsu Maekawa/Now Production/Music Worx sound driver, such as Supapoon, Sporting News Power Baseball, the Super Power League series, etc.), samples @7 and Thunder are omitted. So oh well, here's the obligatory NOT COMPATIBLE WITH BONUS END AND BLARGG/THUNDER warning.

Good for mid-level bonus areas.
